name: smartrecruiters-mcp
description: SmartRecruiters (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_smartrecruiters_company_ide.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTRECRUITERS_COMPANY_IDENTIFIER
platform_mcp_smartrecruiters_company_ide.description: The company identifier as it appears at the end of its SmartRecruiters career site, e.g. 'smartrecruiters' in https://careers.smartrecruiters.com/smartrecruiters.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Public Posting API for ONE company (config company_identifier): GET /v1/companies/{companyIdentifier}/postings 'Lists active postings published by given company' without credentials (public postings only). q is the 'full-text search query based on a job title, location'; location is sent as the exact city filter and country as the country-code filter; limit ('max value is 100') and offset page the results (total = totalFound). id is the posting id (use it with get_posting, which adds the job-ad text and URLs). List rows carry no description or URL; department, function, typeOfEmployment, experienceLevel, location.remote/hybrid, uuid and customField[] are in raw.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v1/companies/{companyIdentifier}/postings/{postingId} (posting id or uuid). description is the job-ad 'Job Description' section as HTML; companyDescription, qualifications and additionalInformation sections, applyUrl and referralUrl are in raw.
